title: Braised Lamb Stew
description: A hearty Italian-inspired lamb stew made with tender lamb, fresh herbs, and a hint of acidity from the sour ingredients.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the lamb pieces on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove from pot and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium and add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped red bell pepper and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the browned lamb back to the pot, along with the canned tomatoes, salt, and pepper.
Bring the stew to a boil, then cover and transfer to the oven.
Braise the stew at 300°F (150°C) for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Let the stew rest for 10 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld.
